title: Scheme presentations of a stack diagonal with a morphism property
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal F$ be a category over $\mathit{Sch}/S$, and use scheme-valued discrete groupoids, functors over the base, vertical natural isomorphisms and the $2$-fibre product of [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. For $S$-schemes $T,U,R$, maps $a:h_T\to\mathcal F$, $b:h_U\to\mathcal F$, $p:R\to T$ and $q:R\to U$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base], say that $(R,p,q)$ presents this diagonal test if there is an equivalence over the base $h_R\simeq h_T\times_{\mathcal F}h_U$ whose two projections are vertically naturally isomorphic to $h_p$ and $h_q$. For a property $P$ of scheme morphisms, say that $\mathcal F$ has scheme diagonal with property $P$ if every such pair $a,b$ has a presentation $(R,p,q)$ for which $(p,q):R\to T\times_SU$ has $P$, using the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product].
